title: Mortar Calculator
hint:
Right-click map — place or remove point.
Left-click — pan map (or point).
Mouse wheel — zoom.
hintTouch:
Long press — place or remove point.
One finger — pan map.
Two fingers — zoom.
helpP1: Setting Points. Mark your position (point A) and target (point B) — the calculator will compute distance, azimuth, and elevation.
helpP2: Working with Map. Right-click opens the menu. Left-click pans the map. Mouse wheel zooms. On touch screens: one finger pans, two fingers zoom, long press opens context menu.
helpP3: Coordinates. X and Y are entered in game coordinates (0–160) — the same as shown under the cursor. Change step is 0.01 (arrows in input field).
helpP4: Results. Distance, azimuth from north, barrel angle in mils. If target is out of range — corresponding message.
helpP5: Saving. All data is automatically saved and restored after page reload.
helpP6: About Calculator. Fan-made tool for WARDOGS game. Unofficial project, not affiliated with game developers.
